metadata.title: Natural-regeneration potential in Colombia on HEALPix (WGS84): Williams et al. (2024) map, an independent replication model, and regrowth labels
metadata.description: Multiscale HEALPix NESTED (WGS84) dataset, Zarr v3 in the GRID4EARTH layout, of (1) the published natural-regeneration potential map of Williams et al. (2024, Nature), (2) an independent random-forest replication of that model for Colombia, predicted on every 30 m pixel, and (3) Fagan et al. (2022) and MapBiomas Colombia regrowth labels. All values are areas (m2) summed per cell, levels 15 (~200 m) to 8 (~25 km), with dggs convention and CF metadata. Parquet tables give the sample points and prediction grid with every predictor, label and prediction, so the models can be refitted without the ~21 GB of inputs. Derived from the replication software doi:10.5281/zenodo.23137989, which tests the paper's 87.9 % validation-accuracy claim (verdict: partially supported) following the robustness checks of The Unjournal's evaluation (doi:10.21428/d28e8e57.5411b150).
